meta.description: Optional producer diagnostics (WP-08 addition, additive/backward-compatible — entries without `meta` remain valid). Not consumed by validateLedgerEntry/admitForCore; carried for downstream tooling (accuracy/retrograde tests, later packages) that wants speed/timescale context without recomputing it.

jd_tt.description: Julian Day, Terrestrial Time, at the requested instant.

delta_t_seconds.description: TT - UT1 (approximated as TT - UTC) at the requested instant, seconds.

speed_arcsec_per_day.description: Signed decimal-integer string: ecliptic-longitude rate of change, rounded to the nearest arcsecond/day, via central difference (+/-6h).

retrograde.description: True iff the underlying (unrounded) speed is negative.
